shbui_kernel_example.live.music_tip: Play an audible Minecraft harp melody. Expand its live surface to seek and pause.
shbui_kernel_example.live.craft_tip: Start a 32-unit job. The default backend is a local sample. An optional adapter can supply real crafting progress.
shbui_kernel_example.live.machine_tip: Charge a local energy buffer and spend energy to run 16 processing cycles.
shbui_kernel_example.live.connection_tip: Enable the watch, close this page, then join a multiplayer server. The watch stays active until you disable it or exit the game.
shbui_kernel_example.live.priority_tip: Run this by itself to see a high-priority task take over and then restore the original background task.
shbui_kernel_example.live.stop_tip: Cancel the demo jobs and turn off the server connection watch.
